parameters.role: An expert legal analyst specializing in Chilean law, with extensive experience in identifying connections between legal articles.
parameters.context: Legal regulations and rules relating to the Ley General de Urbanismo y Construcciones (LGUC) and the Ministerio de Vivienda y Urbanismo (MINVU) of Chile.

LGUC.description: A specific article from the LGUC (Ley General de Urbanismo y Construcciones). Must explicitly mention or refer to the LGUC, ignore articles from other legal bodies such as OGUC/DDU.

node_name.description: The unique identifier of the LGUC article.
node_name.description_hybrid: The unique identifier of the LGUC article. Must be in the format: lguc_articulo_<A>_<NUM>_<LETTER>, where <A> is a valid integer without any leading '0's, <NUM> is optional and must be a latin adverb of iterative value (bis, ter, quater, quinquies, sexies, septies, octies, nonies, decies, undecies...), and <LETTER> is an optional letter that may only appear if <NUM> is also present. All of this is usually mentioned in the text as: artículo <A> <NUM> <LETTER>.

filename.description: The name of the internally associated text file.

source.description: The name of the parent document.

source_type.description: The type of the parent document.

url.description: The url of the original document.

bcn_id_norm.description: A unique identifier within the platform of the BCN (Biblioteca del Congreso Nacional de Chile).

bcn_id_part.description: A unique identifier within the platform of the BCN (Biblioteca del Congreso Nacional de Chile).

name.description: The name of the LGUC article.

date.description: The date of the LGUC article.

scope.description: The scope of the LGUC article.

title.description: The title of the LGUC article. Mentioned in the beginning, right in between 'TITULO' and 'CAPITULO': TITULO N <TITLE> CAPITULO M. Should be textual, exactly as it appears in the document.

chapter.description: The chapter of the LGUC article. Mentioned in the beginning, right in between 'CAPITULO' and 'Artículo': CAPITULO M <CHAPTER> Artículo X. Should be textual, exactly as it appears in the document.

summary.description: A summarized explanation of the contents of the LGUC article. Should be concise and mention all the relevant components and details.

OGUC.description: A specific article from the OGUC (Ordenanza General de Urbanismo y Construcciones). Must explicitly mention or refer to the OGUC, ignore articles from other legal bodies such as LGUC/DDU.

node_name.description: The unique identifier of the OGUC article.
node_name.description_hybrid: The unique identifier of the OGUC article. Must be in the format: oguc_articulo_<T>.<C>.<A>_<NUM>_<LETTER>, where <T>, <C>, <A> are valid integers without any leading '0's, <NUM> is optional and must be a latin adverb of iterative value (bis, ter, quater, quinquies, sexies, septies, octies, nonies, decies, undecies...), and <LETTER> is an optional letter that may only appear if <NUM> is also present. All of this is usually mentioned in the text as: artículo <T>.<C>.<A> <NUM> <LETTER>.

filename.description: The name of the internally associated text file.

source.description: The name of the parent document.

source_type.description: The type of the parent document.

url.description: The url of the original document.

bcn_id_norm.description: A unique identifier within the platform of the BCN (Biblioteca del Congreso Nacional de Chile).

bcn_id_part.description: A unique identifier within the platform of the BCN (Biblioteca del Congreso Nacional de Chile).

name.description: The name of the OGUC article.

date.description: The date of the OGUC article.

scope.description: The scope of the OGUC article.

title.description: The title of the OGUC article. Mentioned in the beginning, right in between 'TITULO' and 'CAPITULO': TITULO N <TITLE> CAPITULO M. Should be textual, exactly as it appears in the document.
title.example: DE LA PLANIFICACIÓN Y DE LOS PLANES DE INVERSIONES EN INFRAESTRUCTURA DE MOVILIDAD Y ESPACIO PÚBLICO

chapter.description: The chapter of the OGUC article. Mentioned in the beginning, right in between 'CAPITULO' and 'Artículo': CAPITULO M <CHAPTER> Artículo X.Y.Z. Should be textual, exactly as it appears in the document.
chapter.example: DE LAS NORMAS DE URBANIZACIÓN Y DE LOS APORTES AL ESPACIO PÚBLICO

summary.description: A summarized explanation of the contents of the OGUC article. Should be concise and mention all the relevant components and details.

DDU.description: A specific circular from the DDU (División de Desarrollo Urbano). Must explicitly mention or refer to the DDU, ignore other legal bodies such as LGUC/OGUC.

node_name.description: The unique identifier of the DDU circular.
node_name.description_hybrid: The unique identifier of the DDU circular. If the circular is General, then this identifier must be in the format: ddu_grl_<N>, where <N> is a valid integer assigned to the circular, without any leading '0's. If the circular is Specific, then this identifier must be in the format: ddu_esp_<N>_<YYYY>, where <N> is the same as in the General case, and <YYYY> is the year. Do not confuse <N> with the order number, which is a different integer. Assume that all circulars are General unless explicitly stated as Specific. All of this is mentioned in the text as: DDU <N> or DDU-ESPECÍFICA N° <N>/<YYYY>.

filename.description: The name of the internally associated text file.

source.description: The name of the parent document.

source_type.description: The type of the parent document. Can either be a General DDU Circular ('ddu') or a Specific DDU Circular ('ddu-esp'). Assume that all circulars are General unless explicitly stated as Specific.

url.description: The url of the original document.

bcn_id_norm.description: A unique identifier within the platform of the BCN (Biblioteca del Congreso Nacional de Chile).

bcn_id_part.description: A unique identifier within the platform of the BCN (Biblioteca del Congreso Nacional de Chile).

name.description: The name of the DDU circular.

date.description: The date of the DDU circular. Must be in the format: <YYYY>-<MM>-<DD>, where <YYYY> is the year, <MM> is the month, and <DD> is the day. If <MM> is not available, consider it as 01. If <DD> is not available, consider it as 01. If the year is not available, the entire date value should be: NULL.

scope.description: The scope of the DDU circular.

circular_order_number.description: The circular order number. Mentioned near the beginning of the document as: Ord. N° <CIRCULAR_ORDER_NUMBER>. Must be in the format: <N>, where <N> is a valid integer without any leading '0's. If not present, the value should be: NULL.
circular_order_number.description_hybrid: The circular order number. If present, it is mentioned in the text as: Ord. N° <CIRCULAR_ORDER_NUMBER>. Must be in the format: <N>, where <N> is a valid integer without any leading '0's. Must be a different number from the one in 'node_name'. If not present, the value should be: NULL.

subject.description: The subject matter of the DDU circular. Mentioned near the beginning as: MAT.: <SUBJECT>. Should be textual, exactly as it appears in the document.

keywords.description: A list of keywords associated with the DDU circular. Mentioned right after the 'subject', all in uppercase. Should be textual, exactly as it appears in the document.
keywords.example: PERMISOS; APROBACIONES Y RECEPCIONES, MODIFICACIONES DE PROYECTOS.

summary.description: A summarized explanation of the contents of the DDU circular. Should be concise and mention all the relevant components and details.

LegalProvision.description: A specific legal provision that is referenced in a legal document. Exclude all legal provisions from: LGUC (Ley General de Urbanismo y Construcciones), OGUC (Ordenanza General de Urbanismo y Construcciones), DDU (División de Desarrollo Urbano).

source.description: The name of the legal body that contains the legal provision. Cannot be among: LGUC (Ley General de Urbanismo y Construcciones), OGUC (Ordenanza General de Urbanismo y Construcciones), DDU (División de Desarrollo Urbano). Must be in the format: <TYPE> N° <N>, where <TYPE> is the type of legal body (e.g. Ley, Decreto, Constitución, Decreto con Fuerza de Ley, Código Civil, Código Penal, etc...), and <N> is a valid integer without any dot ('.') characters. Do not consider Artículo or Numeral as <TYPE> or numbers used for them as <N>. If <N> is not mentioned, the format must be: <TYPE>. If <TYPE> is not mentioned, the entire value must be: NULL.
source.example: Ley N° 20600, or Decreto con Fuerza de Ley N° 707, or Código Civil

article.description: The number of the specific article from 'source' that is being considered, if specified. Must be a valid integer without any dot ('.') characters. Do not consider Numeral as the article number.

name.description: The full name of the legal provision. Corresponds to: <SOURCE> Art <ART>, where <SOURCE> is the value of 'source' and <ART> is the value of 'article'. If 'article' is not present, the format must be: <SOURCE>. The entire value must be NULL if <SOURCE> is among: LGUC (Ley General de Urbanismo y Construcciones), OGUC (Ordenanza General de Urbanismo y Construcciones), DDU (División de Desarrollo Urbano).
name.example: Ley N° 20600 Art 20, or Decreto con Fuerza de Ley N° 707 Art 10, or Código Civil Art 200

summary.description: A textual description of the legal provision, summarizing it's official definition in the Chilean law. Should be concise.

References.description: A source/origin legal provision explicitly referencing a target legal provision. The source/origin and target legal provisions must be different. Make sure that the source/origin actually references the target, and not the other way around.

ref_type.description: The type of reference that the source/origin imposes over the target: SOURCE -[<REF_TYPE>]-> TARGET, where <REF_TYPE> can be one of: refiere, interpreta, condiciona, complementa, fundamenta, modifica, deroga, instruye. 'refiere': the source refers to the target. 'interpreta': the source interprets the target. 'condiciona': the source conditions the application of the target. 'complementa': the source complements the target. 'fundamenta': the source provides a basis for the target. 'modifica': the source modifies/updates the target. 'deroga': the source supersedes/abolishes the target. 'instruye': the source instructs/directs actions related to the target.

description.description: An explanation of how the source/origin references the target. Should be concise.
description.example: Se refiere al punto 7.1 de la Circular DDU 279 para justificar un argumento relativo a la copropiedad inmobiliaria.
